applies_to: Private-sector employees. Used only to EXCLUDE the employee's mandatory contributions from taxable compensation (NIRC Sec. 32(B)(7)(f)). Not a tax.

versions.legal_basis: SSS: RA 11199 and SSS Circular No. 2024-006 (effective January 2025). PhilHealth: RA 11223 Sec. 10, PhilHealth Circular No. 2020-0005 (Rev. 1), Advisories PA2025-0002 and PA2026-0042. Pag-IBIG: HDMF Circular No. 460 (effective February 2024).

sources.title: SSS Circular No. 2024-006, Schedule of SSS Contributions for All Business Employers and Employees Effective January 2025 (SSS circulars index)
KPMG Flash Alert 2025-026: SSS contribution rate 15% (employer 10%, employee 5%); MSC PHP 5,000 ('below 5,250') to PHP 35,000 ('34,750 - over')
PhilHealth Advisory No. 2025-0002: premium rate 5.0%, income floor P10,000, ceiling P100,000
PhilHealth Advisory No. 2026-0042 (signed July 21, 2026): premium rate 5.0%
PhilHealth Circular No. 2020-0005 (Rev. 1): premium shared equally by employer and employee; based on monthly basic salary
RA 11223 (Universal Health Care Act), Sec. 10: 5% from 2024, floor P10,000, ceiling P100,000
OCA Circular No. 25-2024 implementing HDMF Circular No. 460: 2% of Fund Salary, maximum Fund Salary P10,000, personal share P200, effective February 2024

verification.notes: SSS: the circular PDF on sss.gov.ph could not be retrieved; the schedule's figures are confirmed by two independent summaries of Circular 2024-006 (KPMG, Grant Thornton), and the SSS circulars index lists no later schedule, so 2024-006 still applies in 2026. MSC brackets are P500 wide and centred on each MSC (e.g. P5,250-P5,749.99 -> P5,500), with everything below P5,250 at P5,000 and P34,750 and over at P35,000; the employee share is 5% of the MSC. PhilHealth premiums are computed on monthly BASIC salary, so pay that includes allowances overstates PhilHealth slightly. Pag-IBIG: the reduced 1% rate for monthly compensation of P1,500 and below was not confirmed from an official source, so contributions are not auto-computed at or below P1,500 a month (the user is asked for them instead). Extend tax_year_to only after checking each agency for a newer circular.
